name: Savage Hew
description: Takes one gliding step forward and drops the falchion in the same breath, the step adding its weight to the cut.

name: Stumphurdle
description: Skips the rear foot up to the front to close a wide gap while the blade stays raised for the chop.

name: Stumpbuckle
description: Steps outside the opponent's thrust and blocks it with the flat so the chop answer is ready.

name: Hack Thwack
description: Plants the lead heel hard and lets the blade fall overhead, the stop of the foot driving the cut downward.

name: Stumpprop
description: Glides backward with the blade held across the front, keeping the guard unbroken through three paces.

name: Brisk Hash
description: Pairs a qi pulse in each leg with a step and a chop, repeating twice so the second cut follows the first closely.

name: Hackhurdle
description: Drives across the opponent's front on a cross-step with qi in the calves, ending beside the unguarded flank.

name: Vicious Heavyback
description: Sets the belly against the opponent's sleeve and drags it back toward the wrist in a short pulled cut.

name: Fierce Whack
description: Turns the thumb side of the grip outward and slices along the belly to open the opponent's forearm.

name: Hewhurdle
description: Steps down a slope of the ground with the blade trailing so the pulled cut gains a long arc.

name: Resolute Chopblade
description: Leads with the spine toward the opponent, holding the blunt back as a ready bar against a hard strike.

name: Harsh Nubtip
description: Swings the hip into a draw cut so the drag across the target is long and steady.

name: Lithe Cleaverbelly
description: Pulls the blade back along the cut as the feet withdraw, leaving no opening for a counter thrust.

name: Grim Wedgetip
description: Feeds qi steadily into the curved belly while dragging it across the target, so the cut deepens with the length of the pull.

name: Viselike Falchhilt
description: Drags the belly down the opponent's blade and into the hand guard, breaking the opponent's guard open.

name: Unmoving Thickspine
description: Holds the broad blade crosswise before the chest so a blow strikes the flat and slides away.

name: Rooted Bulkblade
description: Turns the shoulder as the blades meet so the blow glances along the back edge of the falchion.

name: Ducking Cleft
description: Pivots the heel behind the covering blade to bring the opponent's weapon off line.

name: Rugged Weightbelly
description: Drops the blade onto the opponent's reaching arm from behind the guard as the first blow is turned.

name: Nubhasp
description: Spreads qi along the broad flat so the held falchion stiffens against a series of heavy blows.

name: Resolute Thickspine
description: Turns the opponent's cut away with the flat and sends the blade back on the same path as a chop.

name: Gap Clipedge
description: Draws breath while gathering qi toward the swollen end of the blade, feeling where the weight sits.

name: Brawn Chunk
description: Lets the gathered weight carry the blade down in an overhead cut that needs little arm effort.

name: Draught Clipedge
description: Shifts the blade's balance forward as the arm turns, so the hack carries beyond the target's guard.

name: Sleet Falchhilt
description: Holds the heavy end high and forward so it covers the head and one shoulder at once.

name: Clay Hack
description: Slides the front foot with the blade's forward weight pulling the body into the new stance.

name: Acrid Chunk
description: Lets the dense tip rebound off a blocked cut and spring back into a second hack from the other side.

name: Bold Weightbelly
description: Packs qi into the swollen section at the top of the lift so the chop falls with extra mass.

name: Nubtipprop
description: Settles the gathered weight into the broad blade as it meets a blow, throwing the attacking weapon wide.

name: Hew Prop
description: Presses the weighted swell down on the opponent's blade, holding it against the ground with steady qi.

name: Stumpcordial
description: Watches the opponent's shoulder to read the line of an overhead cut a breath before it falls.

name: Draught Nubtip
description: Meets the opponent's blade with the sharpened edge at the instant of impact, stopping the cut cold.

name: Draught Heavyback
description: Slips the head aside from a cut and hacks at the exposed side in the same motion.

name: Claynubtip
description: Rises under a falling blow with the spine and chops downward as the opponent's blade is pushed up.

name: Draught Cleaverbelly
description: Steps backward past a cut and returns a hack as the opponent's weapon passes through empty air.

name: Nubscreen
description: Crosses the wrists to angle the blade so a strong cut slides down the flat into the ground.

name: Honedhew
description: Reverses the direction of a parry in a single motion, turning a defense into a falling chop.

name: Stumpbarrier
description: Hardens the edge with a pulse of qi at the moment of contact, throwing the opposing blow back upon itself.

name: Rugged Wedgetip
description: Overturns the opponent's attack with a parry that flows straight into a heavy falling chop on the open side.

name: Clutching Bulkblade
description: Presses the swell onto the opponent's blade after a parry and twists it from the grip.

name: Nubtipflog
description: Opens a hacking advance with a single heavy chop meant to force the opponent's guard high.

name: Stern Cleft
description: Drives a short hack on each forward step, keeping the opponent's weapon on the defensive.

name: Ember Chopblade
description: Switches the leading hand between hacks so the heavy falchion never pauses at the end of a stroke.

name: Unmoving Clipedge
description: Holds the blade high across the body between hacks so no counter finds an opening.

name: Grit Whack
description: Keeps the feet driving along a straight line toward the opponent, hack by hack.

name: Static Hack
description: Links three hacks with qi circulating through the shoulders so the opponent is forced backward on every one.

name: Dusknubtip
description: Drives hack after hack until the opponent's back meets a wall or post and has no room to answer.

name: Weighty Hew
description: Hooks the opponent's blade with the spine near the hilt and holds it for a breath.

name: Burdening Wedgetip
description: Lets the falchion's weight rest on the opponent's blade and presses it toward the ground.

name: Ruthless Hash
description: Slides the belly along the pinned blade toward the opponent's hand, cutting as it goes.

name: Stubborn Bulkblade
description: Anchors the back heel hard to the ground to hold a bind against a stronger push.

name: Gallnub
description: Twists the hilt hand under the pinned blade to loosen the opponent's grip.

name: Fleet Weightbelly
description: Steps out of a failed bind with the blade lifted clear before the opponent can follow.

name: Hashbarrier
description: Locks the pinned blade under a steady stream of qi so the opponent cannot free it by strength alone.

name: Statichash
description: Throws the opponent's blade aside by levering the spine down and out from the bind.

name: Dire Heavyback
description: Swings the falchion in a wide horizontal arc at waist height to catch any approach.

name: Fierce Nubtip
description: Flicks the clipped forward edge at the opponent's face to force a flinch.

name: Falchhilt Glide
description: Pivots with the sweeping blade so the swing carries the body smoothly into a new facing.

name: Dense Cleaverbelly
description: Returns the sweep along its path in reverse, turning aside a thrust that follows the first pass.

name: Clay Chunk
description: Pushes qi to the tip so the sweeping cut reaches a hand's breadth further than the steel.

name: Weighty Thickspine
description: Clears the space ahead with repeated sweeping clips so nothing steps inside the falchion's arc.

name: Scudding Heavyback
description: Turns off the line the instant a chop lands, so the answering cut meets only air.

name: Chopblade Scorer
description: Pivots on the ball of the foot and chops back toward the opponent from the new angle.

name: Brassstump
description: Holds the guard steady while the body rotates beneath it, keeping the broad flat between the two fighters.

name: Doughty Whack
description: Chops twice in the rhythm of a turn and a return so the second cut lands as the opponent recovers.

name: Brawn Hew
description: Swings the free hand outward for balance on each turn so the heavy blade does not pull the body over.

name: Rillnub
description: Turns aside from a strike while the flat of the blade sweeps the opponent's weapon off the line.

name: Rough Whack
description: Smooths each turn with a ring of qi at the waist so the chop from the new angle lands cleanly.

name: Nubswerve
description: Spirals out of the opponent's reach on a chop and a turn, ending outside the opponent's counter.

name: Humstump
description: Turns the whole body under a heavy blow so the falchion deflects it past the shoulder with a surge of qi.
